title: Stop Saying "Very Funny"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very funny". Use one of these words instead:
• Hilarious: a hilarious joke
• Hysterical (informal): a hysterical cat video
• Side-splitting: a side-splitting comedy
• Laugh-out-loud: a laugh-out-loud cartoon
• Priceless (informal): a priceless reaction

Full lesson: Stop Saying "Very" in English: 30 Words to Use Instead of "Very" (With Pictures)
